label: prf:nucleon-borromean-topology
title: Proof of nucleon Borromean topology
html: The proton and neutron are each modelled as a Borromean-ring configuration (6_2^3) of three quark vortices. They are bound internally by Hopf links \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Hopf}} representing the strong color-exchange interaction. The Hopf link is a torus link with \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Hopf}}) = 0. Its mass contribution therefore arises entirely from the Skein functional, not from hyperbolic volume. \square
